## Bio

I’m a computational epidemiologist and a postdoctoral associate at Université Libre de Bruxelles (ULB) at the Spatial Epidemiology Lab [(SpELL)](https://spell.ulb.be/) 
working on climate change impact into infectious diseases. 

From 2023 through 2026, I was postdoctoral associate at Yale University with [Nathan Grubgauh](grubaughlab.com/tean), Ted Cohen and [Colin Carlson](https://www.carlsonlab.bio/team) labs.

By training I'm either a physicist (specializing in mathematical and statistical modelling for disease transmission and spread) or 
environmental and climate epidemiologist; professionally, I've worked as a data scientist, full stack developer and barista. 
Outside of work, I like drawing [maps](south_ameria_cell_towers_no_borders_no_caption_no_title.png) and drinking coffee.

On this site I keep a list of [my CV](CV_Rafael_Lopes.pdf)
